set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add scale_space_energy_result with print/summary. Summary must report omnibus_p, best_scale, finest_detected_scale, stable_supported_range, global endpoint, voxelwise endpoint, and supported table by scale/channel. Do not assume monotone support.
